threat_model: honest-but-curious seam observer of fwd seam activations h* (training: the tensor the body receives; inference: prefill seam rows), granted the victim's token embedding matrix E (public base weights — the VFLAIR-LLM VMI white-box assumption); --head-pt additionally grants the victim head transform. With --model alone, calibration forwards use the PUBLIC head — the victim's finetuned head is not assumed and the mismatch is part of the measurement. Canonical tokens are evaluation truth, never an attack input (label-free attack).
interpretation: token-set precision/recall are orderless per-sequence set overlaps (VFLAIR convention); seq_accuracy is position-aligned vs canonical, pooled per token; the control decodes the calibration-corpus majority token at every position (attacker-computable without canonical); the gate verdict is the frozen-gate Bonferroni-Wilson excess over that control with n = scored tokens. Toy tier is a machinery check of the shared ridge/decode/scoring/gate plumbing on a synthetic KNOWN-map seam, not a security claim; real numbers come from --capture-dir runs.
